en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a straight, narrow city street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings on both sides. The perspective looks down the street toward a small church tower or similar structure in the distance. The buildings feature detailed facades, bay windows and window awnings. At the top center of the image, printed text identifies the location as a street in Graz.
